statement:
I'll look up the payment record first.
The record states the membership is "active, renewing for another year" and lists a USD 1,188.00 annual charge against a USD 240.00 balance — but that "active" status is merchant-side data that predates or ignores the 3 July written cancellation the club itself confirmed by email, so it is not authoritative evidence that this charge is owed.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status contradicts the confirmed 3 July cancellation and "is not authoritative evidence that this charge is owed."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
